results.releaseNotes:
We ship new features, improvements, and fixes regularly. Keep auto-update on so you never miss what's next. Here's what's new in this release:

NEW FEATURES:
- Home Screen and Planner UI design update
- Default rerouting behaviour now more as generally expected: 
    - Less strict in considering a waypoint as reached (you don’t have to get as close to it)
    - Added a ‘Skip Radius’ for auto-skipping via points (only via points in the skip radius will be automatically skipped)
    - Default behaviour is now auto-skip waypoint within skip radius after 3 recalculations
- Added setting to switch to shorter verbal instructions (Settings > Sound & Voice Instruction)
- Added options to delete search term history and recent destinations

 BUG FIXES:
- Stability improvements
- Decreased possibility of route taking offramp only to take onramp again
- Fix for color picker being unresponsive when saving a new location by long-pressing on the map
- On CarPlay the icons in the focussed (selected) map button were not readable
- Some voice instruction changes for Hungarian
- Fix for sometimes not being able to scroll all the way up again on iPad in My Routes/My Rides/My Locations. 
- Fix for temporarily not having guidance instruction (visual and audible) after transferring navigation to CarPlay
- Fix for unreached waypoints being greyed out after editing a route during navigation
- Fix for old, already reached, waypoints being reinstated after editing a route during navigation
- Fix for map being stuck at certain rotation angle (not rotating with riding direction) after transferring to CarPlay after editing a route during navigation
- Folder count sometimes wrapping number to 2 lines if it goes into 3 digits
- Debug menu section is now revealed above the version number
- Fix for changes to an existing route sometimes not being saved persistently
- Fix for road closures and traffic incidents not showing on the map
- Doubled character limit for Ride descriptions from 2000 to 4000
- Fix for “Guide back to route” button not working on CarPlay
- Fix for ‘sticky’ route name when importing several routes from a single GPX sequentially

TAKE THE SCENIC ROUTE — The app motorcycle riders swear by. 30 million hours ridden, 200,000+ user-designed routes, 4.7 star rating worldwide.

GET THERE YOUR WAY — Curvy routes, beauty routes, unpaved adventures. Scenic finds the twistiest roads automatically, anywhere in the world. You choose how to get there — the rest is just riding.

PLAN LIKE A PRO — Drop pins, set stops, pick your routing mode. Share your route with fellow riders before you even leave.

DISCOVER EPIC ROADS — Browse thousands of routes shared and rated by local riders. Search any area, generate a round trip, or import a GPX, Google Maps link, or KML file. All your routes, one app.

FOCUS ON THE ROAD — Turn-by-turn navigation, glove-friendly controls, and Apple CarPlay support keep your eyes up and hands on the bars. Speed camera alerts warn you before it matters. Road closures and traffic incidents show up right on the map so you're never caught off guard.

GO OFF GRID — Offline maps with global coverage. No signal, no problem. Ride anywhere.

RELIVE EVERY MILE — Scenic logs your speed, location, and elevation automatically. Add photos along the way. Track your stats over time and share your rides to social media.

results.description:
Looking for an all-in-one motorcycle app that can help you plan your next trip and ensure your safety on the road? Look no further than Detecht! Whether you're a experienced rider or just starting out, Detecht has got you covered. With a range of features designed specifically for motorcyclists, Detecht is the ultimate app to help you stay safe, plan & navigate your routes, and connect with other riders.

The #1 app for people who love riding.

Safety Comes First

One of the most important features of Detecht is its safety tools. With automatic crash detection, safety tracking, and hazard warnings, you can ride with confidence, knowing that Detecht is always looking out for you. Our Automatic Crash Detection system will alert your emergency contacts in the event of an accident, while Safety Tracking keeps you connected to your loved ones with real-time location sharing. Our Hazard Warnings system will notify you of any potential hazards along your route, so you can stay alert and avoid accidents.

Plan Your Next Adventure

With Detecht's Route Planning features, you can create and navigate the perfect trip with just a few taps. Whether you're looking for curvy routes or round trips, Detecht has got you covered. Our planning tool makes it easy to customize your trip based on your preferences with stops, waypoints, and more. You can also explore over 250,000 user tracked routes to find the one that's right for you. The app allows you to plan your route in advance and ride it with our turn-by-turn GPS navigation and voice guidance, so you can focus on enjoying the ride when you're on the road. 

Connect with Other Riders

Detecht's motorbike community is a great way to connect with other riders. Our Social Feed lets you find riding buddies, share your experiences, and stay up to date on the latest news and trends. Take part in the discussions, chat with fellow riders, share routes, and plan your next adventure together.

Other Handy Features

In addition to the safety, route planning, and community features, Detecht also offers other handy tools for motorcyclists. The app supports GPX file formats, making it easy to import and export routes, while the ride statistics feature lets you track your progress and see how far you've come. These tools are perfect for serious riders who want to keep track of their progress and see how they're improving over time.

In summary, Detecht is the ultimate mobile app for motorcyclists, offering a range of features that cater to the needs of all riders. Whether you're a seasoned rider or just starting out, Detecht is the app you need to take your riding to the next level.

Detecht premium is available as an optional upgrade with three different periods, 1 month, 6 months and 12 months. You can subscribe and pay through your App Store account. Your subscription will automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage your subscriptions by entering the user settings in your App Store account after the purchase.

Privacy policy: https://detechtapp.com/privacy-policy

MAXIMUM FUN FOR EVERY MOTORCYCLE ADVENTURE
No matter what motorbike you ride: Activate the tracker to analyze data like lean angle and acceleration after every road trip. Our specialized navigation is more than just a simple motorcycle app – it is your digital companion for a true moto feeling. Make your next outing even more scenic with our route planner, discover hidden twisties, and share your highlights in the community.

UPGRADE TO PREMIUM FOR THE ULTIMATE NAVIGATION
Take your scenic motorcycle navigation to the next level:
Worldwide offline maps and unlimited motorcycle routes
GPS navigation with speed limits and hazard warnings
Professional analysis for your motorcycle: lean angle and acceleration data

Download the calimoto app today! Turn every journey into a scenic adventure with the most advanced motorcycle route planner and GPS navigation available.

ELD COMPLIANCE
The Motive Driver App makes recording Hours of Service (HOS) on your iPhone or iPad fast and easy.
It complies with the FMCSA regulations, including Part 395. When used with the Motive Vehicle Gateway device, the app helps fleets and individual commercial drivers meet their obligations outlined under the ELD mandate. 
Supports current Canadian Federal Hours of Service (HOS) regulations.
Connect the Motive Driver App to the Motive Vehicle Gateway via Bluetooth to stay compliant through an electronic logging device (ELD).
Proactively alerts you when you’re running out of driving time to avoid Hours of Service (HOS) violations.
Displays total hours worked for the week and your available Hours of Service for any given day and the following day.
Can be switched to Inspection Mode to show ELD logs to an officer during a roadside inspection without compromising the driver’s privacy.

TRACKING & TELEMATICS
When dispatched, GPS location data is shared to the Motive Fleet Dashboard to update dispatchers and fleet managers on stops and arrivals.

DRIVER SAFETY
Review Motive Dashcam videos and safety events to understand driving performance. 
See your DRIVE risk score, a benchmark against Motive’s entire network of vehicles.

DISPATCH & WORKFLOW
Confirm and receive assigned dispatches. 
View important load details and manage tasks for active deliveries.
Review past dispatches.
Message your fleet manager or dispatcher directly through the Motive Driver App.
Upload important documents, like bills of lading or accident photos.

MAINTENANCE
Complete pre-trip and post-trip driver vehicle inspection reports (DVIR) so you can report and keep track of any defects.

SUSTAINABILITY
Upload fuel receipts to generate fuel reports in the Motive Fleet Dashboard. 

GET SUPPORT WHEN YOU NEED IT
Call or email our friendly 24/7 support team with any questions.

OVERVIEW
The Motive Driver App is compatible with iPhones and iPads running iOS 10.0 or higher.

Motive Driver App is brought to you by Motive. It’s used by drivers and vehicle operators across many industries including trucking and logistics, construction, oil and gas, food and beverage, field service, agriculture, passenger transit, and delivery. For more information about the Motive Driver App and the FMCSA-registered Motive ELD, visit gomotive.com.

Looking to elevate your riding experience and make it more fun and memorable? Consider using REVER - the world's largest GPS app and community for motorcycle, snowmobile, and off-road enthusiasts. With REVER, it's not just about reaching your destination; it's about enjoying the epic journey, reliving your route, and sharing it with friends.
Whether you're cruising on your motorcycle, exploring on your ATV, shredding on your snowmobile, or off-roading in your 4x4 vehicle, REVER has got you covered. With our extensive community of riders, we help you plan, navigate, and share your ride from start to finish.

DISCOVER AND PLAN YOUR DREAM ROUTES 
REVER offers an extensive selection of hand-picked routes that cater to various preferences, from smooth and paved to rugged and off-road paths. Discover the best locations to explore and customize your ideal ride with our intuitive in-app route planning. With three different routing engines, you can build your own custom routes with our ADVanced Off-Road Planner, Twisty Routing AI Engine or A to B Guidance. 

TRACK, SHARE, AND COMPETE
Record your rides with REVER, keep them public or mark as private, and track your progress with distance, duration, elevation, and speed (you can also hide your max speed). Join the REVER community to share your adventures, compete in challenges, and connect with like-minded riders from around the globe. Plus, share your route and photos on social media to inspire others to explore.

UNLOCK THE PRO MEMBERSHIP ADVANTAGES
Upgrade to REVER PRO membership and unlock the most robust navigation tools and features, including Butler Maps road recommendations, custom turn-by-turn directions with voice navigation, weather radar and alerts, LiveRIDE Safety Features, 3D Flyover and Explore, and much more. With PRO, you'll get premium map styles, and the ability to download GPX files, offline maps and more!


OFFLINE GPS FOR OFF-THE-GRID ADVENTURES
REVER turns your iPhone® into the best GPS device for your adventures. With built-in GPS, REVER can navigate you through your route, even in airplane mode, and record your rides without any cellular network. Plus, with offline maps and rides, you can explore off-the-grid with confidence.

MANAGE YOUR MEMBERSHIP
Your REVER membership automatically renews, but you can turn off auto-renewal at any time. Your iTunes account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. Visit our website for full terms of use.

We are passionate riders just like you, and we want to hear from you. If you have any problems, suggestions, or want to request new features, please contact us at support@rever.co or through the new Help tab.

Unlock the full potential of your motorcycle moments — before, during, and after every ride with Cardo Ride!

Cardo Ride is part of the Cardo family, built to create a complete ecosystem for the ultimate motorcycle experience. From planning epic routes to riding together and reliving your adventures, Cardo Ride enhances every moment on and off the bike.

Cardo Ride is your motorcycle companion, designed to elevate every ride and connect riders across the globe. Our vision is to seamlessly transform your motorcycle routes and memories into shareable adventures, enabling you to make the most out of every moment spent with your bike.

Join the global Cardo Ride community and be part of this extraordinary journey of navigation, riding, and shared motorcycle adventures!

ADVENTURE ROUTING

Discover and conquer the finest routes worldwide, customized to your preferences. Cardo Ride’s intelligent algorithms, combined with community sourced insights and curvy road detection, ensure unparalleled riding experiences — from scenic rides to demanding tours.

PACK RIDE

Effortlessly organize group rides and receive real time notifications — for example, if someone falls behind, if you want to warn your Pack, or if you need a break.
Please note: For unlimited Pack Ride access (beyond 30 minutes), the Pack Leader must be a Cardo Ride PRO member.

TRACKING

Cardo Ride tracks your rides and stores them in your personal roadbook. Add your photos, explore detailed ride statistics, and share your adventures whenever you want.

NEWSFEED & FOLLOWERS

Stay inspired by following fellow riders’ activities, connect with friends, and share your best two wheeled moments.

GETAWAYS

Plan exciting trips with your friends or meet new riding companions through Getaways. Unite with the global Cardo Ride community and expand your riding circle.

AMBASSADORS

Discover Cardo Ride Ambassadors. Connect with experts through the Cardo Ride app, the Cardo Ride Journal, and our social media channels for exclusive tips and insights.

Upgrade to Cardo Ride PRO to unlock:

•  UNLIMITED PACK RIDE – Ride together, stay together  
•  SUPER CURVY ROUTING – Use your personal preferences to discover super curvy motorcycle routes  
•  LIVE TRACKING – Share your live location via a public tracking link  
•  OFFLINE MAPS – Track your rides even in the most remote areas

Ready to transform your motorcycle adventures?

Motoyra is the complete motorcycle logbook and ride tracker for riders who want every ride, every service and every kilometre in one place.

RIDE LOG
Track every motorcycle ride: route, distance, fuel, weather, mood, and a personal rating. Add photos, look back on your best rides, and watch your mileage grow.

SHARE YOUR RIDES
Turn any ride into a story card and share it straight to Instagram, WhatsApp or anywhere else. Planning a trip? Share the route before you even ride it.

MAINTENANCE AND SERVICE
Never miss a service again. Log oil changes, chain, brakes, tires, and more, with clear alerts for what is Due Soon or Overdue, plus reminders before it becomes a problem.

MODIFICATIONS
Record every mod and upgrade: part, brand, cost, rating, and whether you would buy it again. Build a full history of your bike.

EXPENSES
See the real cost of riding, organized by category and year, so you always know what your motorcycle costs you.

BUCKET LIST ROUTES
Collect the roads you dream of riding. Plan them, set your priorities, and check them off as you ride them.

SELLING YOUR BIKE?
Copy your full service history as text and paste it straight into your listing.

MADE FOR RIDERS
• Bike-inspired design with multiple themes
• Metric or imperial units, 40 currencies
• Engine hours instead of odometer, for enduro and motocross
• Your data stays private on your device

Download Motoyra and keep every ride worth remembering.

MyRide has been created with you in mind, the rider. The app allows you to enrich your riding experience, no matter what bike you ride! With MyRide you can track and record your routes, look for new routes to explore, connect with other riders near you and much more.

RIDE & RECORD
- Track your rides with real time statistics such as lean angle, acceleration, speed and more.
- Create your own logbook for each ride with pictures and personal notes. All this information is stored in your own personal account.

CONNECT & SHARE
- Connect with other riders from all over the world.
- Every ride can be shared on social media and also exported to GPX format.

DISCOVER NEW ROUTES
- Being part of this worldwide community of motorcyclists will allow you to find new routes and adventures to go with your motorcycle.

We love to hear your feedback and we are always looking for new ways to improve the MyRide experience.

Enjoy your Ride!

Simple Moto Logbook makes it easy to keep track of motorcycle maintenance.

You love your motorcycle, and you take care of it. You don't want to get stuck in the middle of nowhere because you forgot to replace the chain in time.

You already write down your services in a notebook or somewhere on your computer but wish there was an app to make it easier and faster. 

Now you have Simple Moto Logbook which is specifically designed for that. You just create a record for changing oil, tires, or for any other service you do, and set up reminders to be on time with the next service check.

Use it also to keep track of your gasoline consumption by entering the mileage and gasoline every time you refuel.

Happy riding!

results.releaseNotes:
Your Rides, on the Big Screen

MotoFlow 4.0 brings your rides to iPad — and lets you bring rides in and send them out, right from iPhone and iPad.

• A Real iPad App: Relive your rides on the big screen. The ride list sits in a sidebar with the map and your stats side by side, and tapping a photo opens it in a floating viewer that keeps the map and stats right there beside it.

• A Layout That's Yours: Drag the divider to balance the map and stats, hide the stats panel when you just want the map, and pull the ride list wider. MotoFlow remembers your widths.

• Bring Rides In: Import GPX files right on your iPhone or iPad — open one from Files, Mail, or AirDrop and send it straight to MotoFlow, with duplicate detection so you never get doubles and live progress you can cancel. Importing several at once is part of the Open Road Edition.

• Send Rides Out: Export any ride as a GPX file from your iPhone or iPad, or pick several — or all of them — and send them together as a single zip. On iPad, select multiple rides at once to export or delete in one go.

The way a ride deserves to be relived.

RELIVE YOUR MOTORCYCLE JOURNEYS

Track rides on iPhone and Apple Watch, relive them on iPad, organize on Mac. No subscriptions, no accounts—your rides are yours, forever.

MotoFlow is built natively for the whole Apple ecosystem—iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, and Mac. Discover forgotten rides with GPS tracking and photo integration. Photos automatically mapped to your routes. Find that mountain pass or coastal road you explored years ago, and relive the memories.

ONE-TIME PURCHASE, ALL YOUR DEVICES

Buy once, ride forever. Full ride tracking on iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, and Mac. No recurring fees. No accounts. Just you, your rides, and your memories.

TRACK RIDES ON THE GO

Start GPS tracking with a single tap. Glove-friendly interface designed for riders. Real-time ride stats, beautiful route visualizations, works offline—no internet required for tracking.

Apple Watch: Control recording from your wrist. Glance-optimized display shows key stats during rides without touching your phone.

MADE FOR IPAD

Relive your rides on the big screen. The ride list sits in a sidebar with the map and stats side by side, and tapping a photo opens it in a floating viewer that keeps the map and stats right beside it. Drag to balance map and stats, or hide the panel when you just want the map—MotoFlow remembers your layout.

ORGANIZE YOUR RIDE LIBRARY ON MAC

Your Mac is where memories shine. Browse hundreds of rides, explore detailed maps and statistics. Photos automatically appear at the exact locations where you captured them.

FEATURES FOR RIDERS

• Native Apple experience across iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, and Mac
• Made for iPad—sidebar list, side-by-side map and stats, floating photo viewer
• GPX Import & Export—bring rides in from anywhere and take them with you, right on iPhone and iPad
• Photo integration mapped to your ride routes
• iCloud sync across all your Apple devices
• Real-time GPS tracking with detailed route visualization
• Multiple map styles and elevation profiles
• Offline tracking—no internet required
• Reliable background tracking when the screen is locked
• Automatic ride naming and smart organization
• Stats dashboard with speed and elevation charts
• Multi-ride map view with clustered photo annotations
• Heatmaps show your most-ridden roads
• Shareable stats cards for social media
• Dark mode for night riding
• Battery-efficient tracking for long rides
• Privacy-first: Your ride data stays on your devices

SEAMLESS ECOSYSTEM

Record on iPhone with full mobile GPS tracking. Start and stop from Apple Watch. Relive on iPad's big screen. Analyze and organize on Mac. Everything syncs automatically through iCloud.

IMPORT RIDES FROM ANY GPS DEVICE

Use Garmin, DMD2, or any GPS device? Import GPX files—open one from Files, Mail, or AirDrop and it's in, with duplicates caught for you. Your rides from any tracker, beautifully organized and mapped with photos.

BUILT FOR RIDERS, BY A RIDER

Every feature designed with real riding in mind, by an indie developer who rides. No clutter, no compromises—just the tools you need to track, relive, and treasure every journey.

DATA FREEDOM

• Export any ride as GPX, or many at once as a single zip
• Standard GPX format—compatible with any GPS tool
• Import rides from other GPS apps and devices
• No lock-in—your ride data remains yours forever
• Automatic iCloud backup and sync

Hit the road and let MotoFlow handle the rest. Rediscover why you started riding in the first place. With MotoFlow, every journey becomes a story worth keeping.

Ride the Flow. Keep the Memories.

Note: Continued use of GPS running in the background can decrease battery life. MotoFlow is optimized to minimize battery impact while maintaining accurate tracking. iCloud is used for sync and backup across devices.

Never miss a service interval, insurance renewal, or MOT deadline again.

MotoLogger is a motorcycle maintenance app and digital service log for your bike — track services, fuel, rides, and compliance, then upgrade to unlock AI-powered Smart Chat that reads your owner's manual and answers questions in seconds.

FREE -- GET STARTED INSTANTLY
- Add your bike by scanning your registration document
- Log every service with date, mileage, cost, and photos
- Track fuel fill-ups and ride mileage
- Photo gallery and activity timeline
- Help Chat -- ask Mo how to use MotoLogger, always free

SMART BIKE CHAT (Plus/Pro)
Upload your PDF service manual once. Mo (powered by Claude AI from Anthropic) extracts your bike's maintenance schedule and technical specifications. Then ask anything -- "What oil does my bike take?", "When are my valves due?" -- answered with page references from your actual manual.

SMART MAINTENANCE TRACKING (Plus/Pro)
- AI-extracted maintenance schedules from your specific manual
- Alerts when services are due based on your mileage and time
- Digital service history -- documented proof for resale value
- Export your full service record as PDF

AVAILABLE IN ENGLISH AND SPANISH
The whole app is translated into Spanish (español), not just the store listing -- every screen, alert, and export. Switch language any time in Profile > Settings > Language.

OWNERSHIP ADMIN, SORTED (Plus/Pro)
- Insurance policy tracking with renewal reminders
- Safety inspection tracking for your country -- ITV (Spain), MOT (UK), NCT (Ireland), TÜV (Germany)
- Road tax reminders
- Manufacturer recall notifications for your bike
- Compliance dashboard -- everything in one place

QUICK BIKE SETUP
- Scan your registration document -- AI extracts VIN, specs, and details in seconds
- Or enter details manually with search across thousands of models

MULTI-BIKE GARAGE (Plus: 3 bikes, Pro: 10 bikes)
- Per-bike timelines showing services, rides, and events
- Ride logging with mileage tracking
- Photo galleries organised by bike

YOUR DATA, YOUR DEVICE
Your service manual is stored securely in the EU cloud so you can restore it on any of your devices, with a copy on your phone for instant access. Your maintenance data syncs securely across your devices via Firebase. AI queries (Claude by Anthropic) are sent without your personal identity attached.

Built by a rider, for riders. MotoLogger is the app I built because I needed it for my own bikes.
